g.text: I'll bring You more than a song
is not what You have required
I'm coming back to the heart of worship
And it's all about You, it's all about You
I'm sorry, Lord, for the thing I've made it
When it's all about You, it's all about You
Holy, there is no one like You
Open up my eyes in wonder
Show me who You are and fill me
With Your heart and lead me
In Your love to those around me
I will build my life upon Your love
I will put my trust in You alone
And I will not be shaken
